name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx as a three-site static web server with HTTPS, security headers, Fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, and kernel network hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, service enablement, log directory setup, and post-configuration cleanup.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI application with Python, PostgreSQL, a Git-based application checkout, virtual environment dependencies, database provisioning, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
